safety.publicStaticFetchPolicy: GET only; no query string, cookie, authorization token, or custom request header

local.role: manual UI and History milestone evidence; not raw HTTP

runtime.title: Lucky Dragon
runtime.serverVersionSelection: Platform.getCurVersion() selects v2 when launch field t is non-null; otherwise v1

sourceBehavior: The Loading component preloads prefabs, spines, atlases, shaders, fonts, sounds and other resources.
Main starts Login, then Config, before marking PlayerData online.
The start button remains inactive until both resource progress and PlayerData.IsOnline reach their ready states.
Once ready, the button is activated and its label is populated from GameShell.GetStarted; the Portuguese resource maps it to COMEÇAR.
Clicking it dispatches GO_GAME and plays a click sound.
Main handles GO_GAME by instantiating the game view, fading the shade, and hiding loading/copyright nodes. The click itself does not issue a Spin request.
startInteraction.failureBehavior: If Login or Config has not succeeded, the normal ready gate is not satisfied; the source retains retry/error paths instead of entering paid play.

transport.encoding: For each own field, encodeURIComponent(key/value), replace encoded spaces (%20) with '+', then join pairs with '&'.

responseEnvelope.successCondition: HTTP 2xx and parsed JSON field code string-equal to '200'
responseEnvelope.failure: reject parsed error object; if parsing/status fails synthesize code HTTP<status>

pseudoHeaderRewrite.note: These two values are inserted into the form body by Http.post, not sent as HTTP headers. Other keys in the caller's Headers object are ignored by this transport implementation.

signature.conclusion: No endpoint-specific signature is constructed by the gid42 application bundle. The only request transformation found is URL-form encoding in object insertion order. Engine references to MD5 concern static asset versioning/cache and are not API signing.
signature.scope: static source conclusion only; no API request was sent to verify server enforcement

notes: sip selects the API base rather than becoming an auth form field.
gid is injected from the bundle's raw game id through the game-id to gid rewrite.
The query key token is not the session token used after login; PlayerData.Token is populated from auth response data.token.

endpoints.name: authVerify
endpoints.versionNote: Main constructs a caller Headers key named version, but Http.post recognizes only game-id and web-token; therefore version is not serialized by this static transport.

unknownsAndLimits: No raw auth/config response body was persisted, so response field clues are static consumer expectations rather than live schema validation.
No Spin or History API request was issued; status codes, server-required optional fields, and actual response cardinality remain unverified.

The static source contains a v1 fallback auth/session path when launch t is absent, but the redacted launch observation selected and observed v2 auth/verify.
